assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: uncontrolled movement of P-4105 during a planned shutdown

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on P-4105, M-4105 and PT-4105 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in governing the impoundment, specifically performing dam-safety review and surveillance. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 30 October 2016 an incident occurred on P-4105, M-4105 and PT-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing chemical energy held as hydrocarbon.
